column7: 2026-11-03: JSONStorage sorted-keys default was implemented then reverted (release cut, user will revisit). Plain sort_keys=True default breaks docs with mixed int/str dict keys (e.g. hits {200: 1, 'other': 3}) with TypeError, because json sorts before coercing keys to str. Needed fallback: on TypeError dump unsorted, json.loads, dump again sorted. Test with ingest-shaped docs.
